title: Ek Chadar Maili Si
desc: Rani, a loving wife, leads a peaceful life with her husband, Trilok. However, Rani's life takes a drastic turn when Trilok gets killed, and she is forced to marry her brother-in-law.

title: Junoon
desc: Injured Vikram inherits a cursed fate, transforming into a tiger under every full moon. He must confront terrifying powers, seek a cure, and reclaim his humanity.

title: Jeevan Ek Sanghursh
desc: Karan, a thief, works for Dr Devraj to stop evil Don Rattan. He reunites with his disowned family, changing his life.

title: Shola Aur Shabnam
desc: Karan, an NCC trainee, is wrongly accused of murder. He must clear his name, prove his innocence, and uncover the real killer before judgment is final.

title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
desc: Mala, a poor girl, marries into a wealthy family at the patriarch's request. After his death, she faces abuse from her in-laws and must fight to restore peace and dignity in the family.

title: Mr Azaad
desc: Satyaprakash, a union leader, is killed, leaving his pregnant wife. She's wrongly jailed, dies after childbirth, and the son becomes an orphan. He grows up to be a thief.

title: Chandni Bar
desc: Gritty drama about a young woman who moves to Mumbai after she loses her parents and her town is destroyed by religious strife.

title: Comedy Station
desc: Sahil Khattar and his monkey friend Rancho engage in hilarious, witty conversations that entertain and bring laughter, showcasing their unique and playful bond.
